name: Ysolfane
description: The white-dwarf light of Ysolfane has guided three generations of drift miners and twice as many ghosts. The outer dark holds dwarf worlds nobody bothered to name, each colder than the last. Pilots time their burns to the pulsar remnant next door, when the static clears.

stars.name: Grim Anvil
stars.description: A white-dwarf of 1.071 solar masses, extreme density against the dark. A stellar cinder no larger than a world, cooling through the ages. Long-baseline scopes watch it for the cycle that precedes its next active phase.

planets.name: Umbershallows
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Dust devils wander the basins, and the night side glitters with ice. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

moons.name: Cinder Rubble III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Vaporshallows
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. The air itself is a hazard the suits filter with complaint. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

moons.name: Cinder Pumice I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: Broadmoor
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Storm ovals larger than worlds spin for centuries without fading. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

planets.name: The Rust bank
planets.description: Temperate bands of green and gold suggest a biosphere in full swing. Settlement charters queue for landing windows every season. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

planets.name: Mossfall
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. Sulfur frost rims the high ground between the glowing rifts. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

planets.name: The Rust fall
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Bioluminescent tides mark the shallows where the water runs warm. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

dwarfPlanets.name: Obsidian Outer 2
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.name: Boulder 783
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

belts.name: Ash Trojans
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Lone Thread
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
